items.title: Home Depot earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Home Depot Inc (HD) beat on Nov 17, 2026, but only narrowly. Adjusted EPS was $3.86 vs $3.84 expected (+0.5%). Revenue was $43.4B vs $42.81B, up 4.9% year over year. The stock still trades at $338.99 (-2.45%) as of Nov 17, 3:18 PM EST. Investors were reading the guidance, not the headline.
